# membership interval

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:membershipInterval`](gmeow-membershipInterval.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/membershipInterval>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/versions`](../../slices/versions.md)

The time interval over which this version membership / role claim holds. A relator carries its period this way (matching [`gmeow:usageInterval`](gmeow-usageInterval.md), [`gmeow:taggingInterval`](gmeow-taggingInterval.md), [`gmeow:relationshipInterval`](gmeow-relationshipInterval.md)) rather than via [`gmeow:duringInterval`](gmeow-duringInterval.md), which is reserved for [gufo:Situation-based](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Situation-based) time-scoped relations.
